node_notes.pwm_tim1: This node represents the three PWM outputs generated by TIM1 for the motor driver. The bindings are APP_PWM_U_GPIO_PIN through APP_PWM_W_GPIO_PIN in firmware/configs/app_config.h, and HAL_TIM_PWM_Start plus compare updates are implemented in firmware/platforms/stm32/ihm16m1_platform.c.
node_notes.adc1_currents: ADC1 samples the three phase-current channels exposed by the motor driver. APP_PHASE_U_ADC_PIN, APP_PHASE_V_ADC_PIN, and APP_PHASE_W_ADC_PIN bind PC1, PC2, and PC3 to ADC channels 7, 8, and 9 in firmware/configs/app_config.h and the platform ADC callback.
node_notes.standby_pc9: PC9 controls the STSPIN830 standby state and is driven high for the safe standby configuration. The pin and active level come from APP_STBY_GPIO_PIN and APP_STBY_ACTIVE_LEVEL, while ihm16m1_platform_gpio_write uses HAL_GPIO_WritePin.
node_notes.ihm_driver: The portable X-NUCLEO-IHM16M1 driver validates configuration and invokes the supplied callbacks for PWM safety, standby, mode selection, ADC, and fault access. Its API and safety ordering are implemented in firmware/drivers/x_nucleo_ihm16m1/x_nucleo_ihm16m1.c.
node_notes.fault_pa11: PA11 is the active-low EN/FAULT feedback input used by the platform adapter. firmware/platforms/stm32/ihm16m1_platform.c configures APP_EN_FAULT_GPIO_PIN as a pulled-up input and reads it with HAL_GPIO_ReadPin.
node_notes.stspin830: This is the real X-NUCLEO-IHM16M1 motor-driver board containing the STSPIN830 interface used by the portable driver. Its PWM, EN/FAULT, STBY, and current-feedback connections are represented by the callbacks and pin bindings in the supplied driver and platform files.
node_notes.main_boot: Core/Src/main.c performs HAL startup and calls app_start after clock setup. The empty while loop is not treated as application behavior, so this node only establishes the application entry edge.
node_notes.app_owner: firmware/app/app.c owns application bring-up and creates the callback table consumed by the portable driver. It starts the STM32 platform, selects three-PWM mode, checks handle storage, and reports initialization results through LOGE or LOGI.
node_notes.platform_owner: The STM32 adapter translates the portable motor-driver callbacks into HAL GPIO, TIM1, and ADC1 operations. Its implementation is firmware/platforms/stm32/ihm16m1_platform.c, including the PA8-PA11, PC9, and PC1-PC3 wiring.
node_notes.motor_load: The GBM2804H-100T is the motor model declared for this application. It is the physical load driven by the STSPIN830 three-phase output, as identified by APP_MOTOR_MODEL.

node_notes.safe_standby: Successful bring-up ends with a log stating that the driver is in safe standby and the motor remains stopped. This message is emitted at firmware/app/app.c:51.
node_notes.check_storage: The driver handle is placed in static byte storage and its required size is checked before initialization. The size comparison is in firmware/app/app.c:39-42.
node_notes.driver_error: A driver initialization failure is logged and terminates app_start. The LOGE and return statements are in firmware/app/app.c:46-48.
node_notes.wire_callbacks: The application populates the x_nucleo_ihm16m1_io_t structure with platform PWM, GPIO, ADC, and delay functions. These assignments are visible in firmware/app/app.c:25-33.
node_notes.storage_ok: This branch prevents initialization when the statically allocated driver storage is insufficient. The decision corresponds to the x_nucleo_ihm16m1_handle_size comparison in firmware/app/app.c:39-42.
node_notes.start_platform: app_start first invokes ihm16m1_platform_start to make the motor-control hardware usable. The call is at firmware/app/app.c:18 and the platform implementation begins at firmware/platforms/stm32/ihm16m1_platform.c:44.
node_notes.storage_error: When the handle does not fit, app_start logs the storage problem and returns without touching the driver. The evidence is firmware/app/app.c:40-42.
node_notes.platform_error: A failed platform start is reported with LOGE and causes app_start to return. This is the explicit error path in firmware/app/app.c:20-22.
node_notes.configure_driver: The application requests X_NUCLEO_IHM16M1_THREE_PWM_INPUTS and sets start_in_standby to true. Those configuration values are assigned in firmware/app/app.c:34-36.
node_notes.driver_ok: This branch checks the status returned by x_nucleo_ihm16m1_init. The success and failure handling are implemented in firmware/app/app.c:45-48.
node_notes.enter_app: This step is the application entry reached from main.c after HAL and clock setup. The call is app_start in Core/Src/main.c, and the implementation begins at firmware/app/app.c:10.
node_notes.safety_callbacks: The driver initialization sequence disables PWM, asserts STBY, and selects the configured three-PWM mode before marking the handle initialized. This ordering is implemented in firmware/drivers/x_nucleo_ihm16m1/x_nucleo_ihm16m1.c:51-64.
node_notes.platform_ok: This branch checks the status returned by platform startup before any driver handle is initialized. The failure test and LOGE path are in firmware/app/app.c:19-22.
node_notes.initialize_driver: The portable driver is initialized with the prepared callback table and configuration. The call occurs in firmware/app/app.c:44 and leads to the safety callback sequence in the driver.
node_notes.platform_config: Platform startup configures the GPIO bindings, initializes TIM1 PWM channels, initializes ADC1, and calibrates the ADC. These operations span firmware/platforms/stm32/ihm16m1_platform.c:20-104.
